name: aspen-plus
description: Aspen Plus assistant that works like a senior process engineer: builds models with you stage by stage and can write them as input files (.inp) to open in Aspen; finds how AspenTech's example models set up similar processes; click paths checked against your local Aspen Plus help; run troubleshooting from .his/.cpm/.rep files; balance and KPI checks; calculator and Fortran checks; model review and version comparison. Nothing leaves your computer.
